purpose: Keep the learning interface consistent while allowing each micro-topic's content structure to emerge from the evidence and source material actually available.
notes_rule: Use the four notes sources as a synthesis pool. Do not force all four into every topic; use only relevant supported material.
mcq_rule: Use PowerWithin, REVISATHON and verified PYQs for practice. Do not present a practice question as a PYQ unless its provenance is verified.
ui_rule: The renderer accepts variable note blocks. Empty or unsupported blocks are omitted rather than replaced with filler.
retrieval_rule: Recall and application remain separate from notes so the learner must retrieve rather than repeatedly reread.
